text:
aria: onboarding smoke for saffron-70k-int3-hybrid shows a reproducible drop in KV hit-rate and output drift after ~13k tokens on long prompts (>48k).
eli: minimal repro?
aria: `python tests/repro_longctx.py --model saffron-70k --quant int3-hybrid --ctx 65536 --seed 99`
aria: behavior: first ~13k tokens identical to fp32, then small rotary multiplier drift and many key misses.
cheng: any ring index logs?
aria: saw this sequence in logs: `KV_SHARD=4 idx=262143 -> 262144` then immediately `idx=0` which looks like wrap at 2^18 boundary.
rach: 2^18 boundary is suspicious, int3 packing tile is 512 tokens aligned to 2^9; combination might produce unexpected boundary offsets.
oz: could be buffer alignment/padding dropped for tail tiles causing index arithmetic to underflow.
aria: also spotted tiny attn_scale diff at token ~13024: `FP attn_scale=0.9979 vs INT3=0.9935`.
eli: different from usual 10240 hotspot. interesting. maybe rotary rescale LUT differs for this model.
cheng: quick check: does disabling prefetch change anything?
aria: prefetch off -> same divergence, but the wrap log disappears and instead we see `KV_COPY len=0` at same token region. points to memcpy slicing issue.
rachel: can you dump raw key vectors around the transition for fp32/int3? small diffs will tell if key mismatch or index math.
aria: doing that now; will upload to s3.
ci-bot: job queued: rhyme/nightly/saffron-longctx-compare at 2026-04-01T05:00Z. artifacts: s3://rhyme-artifacts/saffron/1932101234/ (kv-raw, traces, logits).
oz: mitigation idea: when loading keys from cache, tolerant-compare by cosine similarity > 0.9995 for int3 models to avoid brittle equality checks. also instrument a small roll-forward that snaps keys if within epsilon.
cheng: prefer deterministic fix: check packing/pad math at tile boundaries; add assertions in packer that produced buffer length % tile_size == 0.
eli: agree do both: quick tolerant-compare behind a rollout flag while we fix packer. add unit that fuzzes tail-padding and asserts stability for 48k/65k ctx.
aria: will prototype tolerant-compare feature and packer asserts. making a branch saffron/kv-tolerant-1932101234.
rachel: add a small goldset long-QA eval in the PR pipeline to catch regressions.
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/5842 by aria  tests queued.
aria: thanks, I'll drop a link to the raw kv dumps when ready.
eli: if tolerant compare hides a deeper bug, ensure we add an automated alert if hit-rate changes >5% post-rollout.
oz: also run kernel generator with exact rotary path fallback for long ctx as a fallback plan.
aria: will do both. pairing with cheng on packer asserts later today.
